_comment: Bedrock School Calendar for 2026-2027, derived from SJUSD's official Student Calendar PDF.
This file is the AUTHORITY on Non-School Days. ParentSquare and MealViewer are
cross-checks, never the source of truth.
ELEMENTARY ONLY. The district PDF's sidebar lists early-release blocks that apply to
SECONDARY schools only (14-17 Dec 2026, 24-26 May 2027). They are deliberately absent
from minimumDays: Trace runs a normal day on them. Reading the sidebar alone would put
four wrong early-release days on the Board.
DO NOT derive holidays with a generic US-holiday library. SJUSD holds school on
Indigenous Peoples' Day (12 Oct 2026) and Cesar Chavez Day (31 Mar 2027). March 2027
contains no non-school days at all. Formula-based holidays would close school wrongly.
See docs/adr/0003-bedrock-school-calendar.md for why this is hand-maintained data.
